verdict.rationale: Background automation, such as scheduled or autonomous tasks run on managed machines, is a fair question for remote-access and management tools, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows RustDesk offering automations that run on their own. Unattended access (permanent-password remote control) is an adjacent feature. The Server Pro management API is only a developer building block. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
